hook: ORR van-truck crash near exit 18 leaves *3 dead, 14 hurt*
hook_b: ORR van-truck crash near exit 18 leaves *3 dead, 14 hurt*
tldr: Three workers died and 14 were injured near the Telangana State Police Academy on ORR.

beats.what: The workers were returning from a job at Muchintal to their pickup point in Moinabad around 11 pm.
beats.why: Police said the truck took a right turn without indicators and the van rammed it.
beats.care: Late-night ORR travel and sudden lane changes near exit ramps are a known risk.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TOI: the injured are out of danger, Rajendranagar police said.

cards.q: Do you feel safe on the ORR at night?

qs: How visible are exit ramps on the ORR at night?

facts.t: All *17* occupants, including the driver, were injured.

watch: The police probe into both drivers under BNS negligence sections.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: 3 killed, 14 injured as van rams into truck on ORR

fact: A van carrying *17 workers* rammed a truck on ORR near exit 18.
twist: Police say the truck turned right without indicators; both drivers were booked.
